name: Higgsfield Supercomputer
desc: Agent that plans, generates and publishes creative work from one prompt
desc_zh: 一句话起步，自动查资料、生成、规划并发布的智能体
solves: Finding references, generating, scheduling and publishing sat in four different tools; describe the task once and the agent runs the chain.
solves_zh: 查资料、生成、排期、发布分散在四个工具里；把任务描述一次，智能体把整条流程跑完。
best_for: You need a ten-post product campaign live by Monday; brief Supercomputer on Friday and review what it drafts.
best_for_zh: 周一要上线一组十条的产品宣传内容；周五把需求交给 Supercomputer，周一早上审稿。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：B+D — a16z Top 100 7th edition names Higgsfield; entry read in https://higgsfiel）。 The date and the sentence are adjacent text nodes of one changelog entry titled 'Higgsfield Supercomputer'; availability line says 'paid plans'. Later additions to the same product (Higgsfield Games 2026-06-10, Higgsfield Apps 2026-07-07, App Builder 2026-06-26, Projects 2026-08-23, AI Employees 2.0 2026-06-19) are not separate entries. 首次公开日期来源：https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog
